stress.note: 本站自製，只用每日收盤：動能品質＝Φ(0.7 × 近 21 天報酬 t 值)；賣壓累積＝兩條線各佔一半（0–100）：慢線在短線動能（跨度 10 天的指數加權）低於 0.45 時累加、高於時以同樣速度遞減；快線用「當天報酬 ÷ 近 30 天波動」的 5 天平均加減，大跌當天就反應；到 100 要兩條都到；2026-11-11 起改成這個平均版，歷史讀數重算；只作讀值、不是買賣訊號

orderbook.note: 快照；寬範圍只收整本掛單簿可得的場所（現貨 Coinbase／Bitstamp／Gemini／Bitfinex，永續 Deribit／Kraken／Hyperliquid）；Binance、OKX 等 API 只回近價約 ±1%，只放在近價圖；寬範圍每 1,000 美元一格（買方格 [p, p+1000)、賣方格同）；USDT／USDC 視同美元；掛單可隨時撤，只作讀值

powerlaw.note: log10(價)＝a＋b·log10(距 2009-01-03 天數)，每天只用當天以前的 CoinMetrics 價格擬合（無前視）；頂部推估＝最近一次頂部倍數 ÷ 過去每輪縮小倍數（最大～最小），乘 2029-10-01 合理價；樣本只有 4 輪，僅作長期路徑交叉驗證，不連動倉位

framework.name: Daybreak 出場框架 v3
framework.unit: 以「100% ＝ 本週期打算賣出的全部持倉」計，不涉及任何人的實際持倉
framework.unit_en: Measured as "100% = everything you plan to sell this cycle"; no one's actual holdings are involved

hedge.rule: 收盤連 5 日在 200 日均線之下 → 減 20%；連 5 日收回或 MVRV Z 7 日均 < 0.5 → 補回
hedge.rule_en: Close below the 200-day MA for 5 straight days → cut 20%; buy back after 5 straight closes above it, or when the MVRV Z 7-day average < 0.5

onchain.rule: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點連 5 日 ≥ 0.75 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: MVRV ÷ prior-cycle peak ≥ 0.75 for 5 straight days → sell one step

onchain.rule: 連 5 日 ≥ 0.80 → 再賣一階
onchain.rule_en: ≥ 0.80 for 5 straight days → sell one more step

onchain.rule: 前兩條觸發過後，每次收盤創新高但 MVRV ≤ 一年最高的 0.9 倍 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: After both have fired: each new closing high with MVRV ≤ 0.9× its 1-year high → sell one step

framework.top3: MVRV Z／NUPL／Puell 四年百分位任兩項 ≥ 80 標為頂部區，只作讀值、不連動賣出。原本的加速規則（≥ 85 多賣兩階、≥ 90 全部賣完）在過去四輪都於週期中段先觸發，2026-11-05 取消
framework.top3_en: Any two of the MVRV Z / NUPL / Puell 4-year percentiles at ≥ 80 marks the top zone; a reading only, with no selling attached. The old acceleration rule (≥ 85 sell two extra steps, ≥ 90 sell everything) fired mid-cycle first in all four past cycles and was dropped on 2026-11-05
framework.time_stop: 2029/10–2030/03 剩餘部位每月等量賣完
framework.time_stop_en: 2029/10–2030/03: sell the remainder in equal monthly amounts

title.zh: 價格貼近短期持有者最厚的籌碼（−0.29%）
title.en: Price near the thickest short-term holder pile (−0.29%)

means.zh: 價格貼近短期持有者籌碼最厚的地方：很多人在這裡買進，價格回到這裡時常出現解套賣壓，站穩之後則會轉為支撐。
means.en: Price is near the thickest pile of short-term holder coins: many bought here, so price often meets break-even selling, which turns into support once it holds.

rule.zh: 收盤離短期持有者最厚的那一格不到 3%。
rule.en: The close is within 3% of the thickest short-term holder band.

title.zh: 持有者行為：4 項同時異動

fig.zh: 短期持有者 SOPR 到近一年最低的 2%、短期持有者獲利 ÷ 虧損 7 日急降、價格貼近短期持有者最厚的籌碼（−0.29%）、短期持有者連 11 天賠錢賣（SOPR < 1）
fig.en: STH-SOPR at a 1-year low (bottom 2%); STH profit ÷ loss: sharp 7-day drop; Price near the thickest short-term holder pile (−0.29%); STH-SOPR below 1 for 11 days in a row

means.zh: 同一類的好幾項同時異動：單一指標可能是雜訊，同類多項一起動比較值得注意；各項的意思看各自的說明。
means.en: Several signals of the same kind fired together: one indicator alone can be noise, several moving at once deserve more attention; see each one for its meaning.

rule.zh: 同一類有 3 項以上同時異動（這次 4 項）。
rule.en: Three or more signals of the same kind at once (4 this time).

title.zh: 短期持有者 SOPR 到近一年最低的 2%

caveat.zh: 日線，盤中集中認賠會被同一天的獲利賣出平均掉
caveat.en: daily; intraday capitulation gets averaged with same-day profit taking

decomp.zh: 拆解：和 7 天前比，實現獲利 −27.10%、實現虧損 +174.50%，主要是認賠變多
decomp.en: breakdown: versus 7 days ago, realized profit −27.10%, realized loss +174.50%; mainly more loss selling

means.zh: 短期持有者普遍賠錢賣：短期持有者在認賠出場，常出現在恐慌或回檔的低點附近；認賠潮過去後賣壓會減輕。
means.en: Short-term holders are selling at a loss: short-term holders are capitulating, typically near panic or pullback lows; selling pressure eases once the wave passes.

rule.zh: 把近一年每天的數值排名，今天落在最低的 2%（第 1.6 百分位）。
rule.en: Ranked against every day of the last year, today is in the bottom 2% (percentile 1.6).

title.zh: 短期持有者獲利 ÷ 虧損 7 日急降

caveat.zh: CheckOnChain 已平滑，單日大額轉帳也會被算成賣出
caveat.en: smoothed by CheckOnChain; a single large transfer can show up as selling

means.zh: 短期持有者獲利 ÷ 虧損一週內明顯降低，虧損已經大於獲利：認賠在擴大。
means.en: STH profit ÷ loss fell sharply this week and losses now exceed profits: loss-taking is spreading.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 1.7 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 1.7).

title.zh: 相對未實現獲利跌到地板
title.en: Relative unrealized profit at the floor

means.zh: 全體未實現獲利佔市值的比例跌到 35% 以下：2012 年起只有週期底部附近出現過（2015、2018–19、2020/03、2022、2026/06）。
means.en: Total unrealized profit fell below 35% of market cap: since 2012 this has only happened near cycle bottoms (2015, 2018–19, March 2020, 2022, June 2026).

rule.zh: 相對未實現獲利（未實現獲利 ÷ 市值）≤ 35%。
rule.en: Relative unrealized profit (unrealized profit ÷ market cap) at or below 35%.

title.zh: 短期持有者連 11 天賠錢賣（SOPR < 1）
title.en: STH-SOPR below 1 for 11 days in a row

means.zh: 短期持有者連續多天賠錢賣：認賠潮延續，短期持有者的耐心在耗盡；歷來長段認賠之後常接近局部低點，但會持續多久不一定。
means.en: Short-term holders have sold at a loss for many days running: the capitulation is dragging on; long stretches like this have often been near local lows, but how long they last varies.

rule.zh: 同一方向連續 11 天（5 天以上才列）。
rule.en: 11 days in a row in the same direction (listed from 5 days).

title.zh: ETF 連 7 個交易日淨流出
title.en: ETF net outflows 7 trading days in a row

means.zh: ETF 連續淨流出：美國現貨需求轉弱，傳統資金在撤。
means.en: Consecutive ETF net outflows: US spot demand is fading as traditional money pulls back.

rule.zh: 同一方向連續 7 天（5 天以上才列）。
rule.en: 7 days in a row in the same direction (listed from 5 days).
